tei:div.tei:p: bzlog pa'i phrin las bcol ba rgyas par 'dod na/ ling ro dmar gtor sha khrag gis brgyan pa 'bul zhing*/ hūm̐ bh+yo: mthing nag gru gsum gzhal yas nas: sangs rgyas kun gyi mthu stobs bdag: rak+sha thod phreng dbyings nas bzhengs: 1$0000250❀1$0000300 dgra bgegs dam sri bsgral pa yi: sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: lo zla zhag dus la 'khor ba'i: che sri chung sri dar ma'i sri: pho sri mo sri rgas gzhon sri: nad sri dur sri ngan pa dang: glo bur rtsub pa'i keg rigs kun: zlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlogs: gnod byed bgegs kyi steng du zlogs: sgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra la sgyur: zlog sgyur bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yo: steng phyogs tshangs pa'i gdan steng nas: hūm̐ chen kā ra dbyings nas bzhengs: dgra bgegs dam sri sogs 'gre/ hūm̐ bh+yo: shar phyogs dri za'i gdan steng nas: rnam par rgyal ba dbyings nas bzhengs: dgra bgegs dam sri sogs/ hūm̐ bh+yo: shar lho me lha'i gdan steng nas: dbyug pa sngon po dbyings nas bzhengs: dgra bgegs dam sri sogs/ hūm̐ bh+yo: lho phyogs gshin rje'i gdan steng nas: gshin rje'i gshed po dbyings nas bzhengs: dgra bgegs dam sri sogs/ hūm̐ bh+yo: lho nub srin po'i gdan steng nas: mi g.yo mgon po dbyings nas bzhengs: 1$0000250❀1$0000300 dgra bgegs dam sri bsgral pa yi: sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: lo zla zhag dus la 'khor ba'i: che sri chung sri dar ma'i sri: pho sri mo sri rgas gzhon sri: nad sri dur sri ngan pa dang: glo bur rtsub pa'i keg rigs kun: zlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlogs: gnod byed bgegs kyi steng du zlogs: sgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra la sgyur: zlog sgyur bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yo: nub phyogs klu dbang gdan steng nas: rta mgrin rgyal po dbyings nas bzhengs:
